ticker_news.title: 5 Smart Stocks to Buy Right Now
ticker_news.description: The article recommends five technology stocks as buying opportunities: Microsoft (trading at 24x forward earnings, down recently), Amazon (stock down 20% with accelerating AWS growth), Alphabet (strong AI positioning), The Trade Desk (down 80% from highs but trading at 12x forward earnings), and Broadcom (expecting 100% AI chip growth in Q1). The author believes these stocks offer excellent long-term returns despite recent market weakness.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

ticker_news.title: Wix Launches Integration With Google Search, Google Maps and Google AI Mode to Turn Queries Into Instant Bookings
ticker_news.description: Wix announced a new integration with Google Search, Google Maps, and Google AI Mode that enables Wix Bookings users to display services, pricing, and real-time availability directly in Google's search experiences. The integration automatically syncs appointment availability approximately every 30 minutes and allows customers to book directly from search results without leaving the page. The feature is currently available for Beauty services with plans to expand to other verticals.
ticker_news.author: Na

ticker_news.title: Billionaire Investor Bill Ackman Has Nearly 40% of His Hedge Fund Invested in Just 3 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks
ticker_news.description: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square Capital Management has concentrated nearly 40% of its portfolio in three AI stocks: Alphabet (14%+ allocation), Amazon (recent stake), and Meta Platforms ($1.8 billion position as of Q4 2025). Ackman believes these companies represent compelling valuations and strong AI positioning, though valuations have risen and execution risks remain.
ticker_news.author: Bram Berkowitz

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Slip As Dow, Nasdaq 100 Gain Following Trump's Tariff Threat — Whirlpool, Uber, HP In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures rose on Tuesday following Monday's sell-off triggered by AI-related economic concerns and a viral 'Global Intelligence Crisis' report. Market sentiment remains cautious amid Trump's tariff threats and geopolitical tensions. Key movers include Keysight Technologies surging 16% on strong earnings, Vir Biotechnology jumping 63% on revenue beat, and Whirlpool plunging 7.46% after announcing an $800 million capital raise.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
